channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Fox News poll: Republican Mike Rogers leads progressive Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan
item.description: Fox News survey places Republican Mike Rogers ahead of anti-Israel Democrat Abdul El-Sayed 51% to 47% in Michigan's Senate contest.

item.title: American actress Hayden Panettiere passes away at 36
item.description:
American actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at the age of 36. Panettiere was widely known for her roles in the hit US television series "Heroes" and "Nashville."
US media outlets reporting her death did not provide details regarding the cause or circumstances of her passing.

item.title: Iran advances law imposing prison terms for interviews with 'hostile' media
item.description: Iran advances law imposing prison terms for interviews with 'hostile' media

item.title: Zvi Yehezkeli slams Kushner’s meeting with Hamas officials: A slap in Israel's face
item.description: Middle East analyst Zvi Yehezkeli harshly criticizes Jared Kushner’s meeting with senior Hamas officials in Egypt: "The very occurrence of this meeting is a victory for Hamas - legitimizing and normalizing the group."

item.title: Iranian Speaker claims war victory after Trump threatens to take control of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's parliament speaker declares victory over the US and Israel, after officials reject Donald Trump's assertion that the US will control the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: 5.8-magnitude earthquake felt in Indonesia
item.description:
A 5.8-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in Indonesia.
No injuries or damage have been reported so far.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic drops to near standstill following tanker attacks
item.description: Ship tracking data shows transit through the Strait of Hormuz nearly stopped over the weekend following attacks on UAE vessels and stalled US-Iran talks.

item.title: South Korea clarifies: Joint military exercises with US will proceed as planned
item.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Defense announced that joint military exercises with the United States military "will take place as scheduled."
The announcement comes as a direct response to statements by US President Donald Trump, who announced he had ordered a significant scale-back of joint training due to his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

item.title: 'Too many Jews': France launches probe over antisemitic refusal of service at resort stand
item.description: French police launch a criminal probe into a resort cafeteria owner filmed telling a Jewish customer there were "too many Jews" and denying service.

item.title: Trump praises Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan over joint defense agreement
item.description:
US President Donald Trump on Sunday praised Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan for the joint defense agreement they recently signed.
"Very happy to see that Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have recently, and finally, signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. It shows how the Middle East is coming together, and how Countries will finally be able to defend themselves in a more meaningful way. Congratulations to the Great Leadership of the three Nations mentioned. THIS IS A BIG, BOLD, AND IMPORTANT FIRST STEP - WOW!" wrote Trump in a post on Truth Social.

item.title: Hamas demands Board of Peace compel Israel to honor Gaza peace plan
item.description: Following high-level talks in Egypt with US envoy Jared Kushner, Hamas demands the Board of Peace compel Israel to fulfill its commitments under the Gaza plan.

item.title: Man moderately injured in accident near Regba Junction
item.description:
A man in his 50s was moderately injured in a two-car collision on Highway 4 near Regba Junction.
Magen David Adom EMTs and paramedics provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him to the Galilee Medical Center in Nahariya.

item.title: Citing relations with Kim, Trump directs Pentagon to cut back drills with South Korea
item.description: Citing high expenses and his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, President Donald Trump orders Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to scale back drills with South Korea.

item.title: Man seriously injured in accident near Moshe Dayan Interchange
item.description:
A 31-year-old man was seriously injured in a road accident near the Moshe Dayan Interchange.
Magen David Adom paramedics evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital in Holon.

item.title: Tragedy in Finland: Missing Israeli cyclist found dead
item.description: The body of a 66-year-old Israeli citizen who went missing during a solo cycling trip in Finland last week has been discovered by the roadside.

item.title: Secret documents reveal: How mechanism for transferring Qatari funds to Hamas was approved
item.description: Documents from 2021 reveal backchannel talks and the approved mechanism to transfer millions of dollars through fuel sales.

item.title: Police open investigation after flags defaced in Binyamin
item.description:
Israeli flags displayed at Rawabi Square, near the community of Ateret in the Binyamin region, were vandalized. Officers from the Binyamin police station collected evidence at the scene and launched an investigation to identify those responsible.
Police said they view any damage to Israeli flags and state symbols with utmost seriousness.

item.title: Jared Kushner arrives in Israel
item.description: US President Donald Trump’s envoy Jared Kushner landed in Israel ahead of talks with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Gaza.

item.title: Regional police chief: 'Place Judea and Samaria Border Police under district authority'
item.description: Judea and Samaria police chief Moshe Pinchi says plan to transfer civilian law enforcement powers from IDF to police requires resources, deploying forces, and placing Judea and Samaria Border Police under the district's authority.

item.title: IDF prepares for days of combat as Hezbollah terrorists trapped underground
item.description: Dozens of Hezbollah terrorists are believed trapped underground as the IDF strikes senior commanders and prepares for several days of combat after ceasefire violation.

item.title: Netanyahu ahead of Likud primaries: I am not interfering in the national slate
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed tomorrow’s Likud primaries, saying he trusts party members to choose their representatives based on their own judgment.
“Tomorrow, I will vote for a winning slate that will ensure that Eisenkot and Yair Golan do not form a narrow government with the Arab parties. I am not interfering in the national slate," Netanyahu said.

item.title: Report: Israel preparing for several days of fighting against Hezbollah
item.description:
The IDF is preparing for the possibility of several days of fighting in Lebanon amid tensions with Hezbollah and military activity in the Ali Taher Ridge and Beaufort Castle areas, according to Channel 12.
According to the report, Israel is determined to destroy terrorist infrastructure in the area, while Hezbollah is attempting to target IDF forces.

item.title: Israeli officer describes finding missing mother and daughter in Argentina
item.description: Israel Police representative Walter Alejandro Kogan recounts the operation that led him to missing Israelis Mali and Liel Yahalomi in Argentina, a week after they were last seen in Vienna.

item.title: US pressure mounts: Kushner arrives in Israel demanding Netanyahu implement Gaza plan
item.description: After meeting Hamas leaders in Egypt, Jared Kushner arrives in Israel to meet Netanyahu. Washington believes PM has agreed in principle to the framework and is demanding its implementation.

item.title: On anniversary of death: US Ambassador Huckabee visits Rabbi Kook's home
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visits Rabbi Abraham Isaac HaCohen Kook’s Jerusalem home and opens an exhibit highlighting Chief Rabbis’ historic White House visits.

item.title: 'Just me, my thoughts, and G-d': Omer Shem Tov recounts Hamas captivity
item.description: Omer Shem Tov releases a new book recounting his 505 days in Hamas captivity, including 50 days alone, and the faith that helped him endure.

item.title: 'It could end in terror': Arabs deface Israeli flags in Binyamin region
item.description: Israeli flags at the Rawabi junction were vandalized with paint after months without incident. Binyamin Council head Yisrael Ganz demands a firm IDF response and warns of escalation.

item.title: Jared Kushner meets with senior Hamas officials in Egypt
item.description:
US President Donald Trump’s advisor, Jared Kushner, met with senior Hamas officials in Egypt today and pressed them to begin fulfilling their commitment to disarm.
Read more.

item.title: Construction workers uncover €9 million treasure hidden in 19th-century Flanden brewery
item.description: Workers renovating a historic Belgian brewery uncovered 49 gold bars and 4,000 ancient coins worth an estimated €9 million-and may now be entitled to a share of the fortune.

item.title: Katzrin unites to commemorate Yehonatan Klimian z"l
item.description: Hundreds of residents, family members, and rabbis gathered for a memorial evening in memory of Yehonatan Klimian z"l, who was killed while rappelling in the Keshet Cave in northern Israel.
